title: The value of an answer that takes a little longer
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Assess the consequence — Ask how difficult an error would be to reverse.; State what is known — Give the useful immediate part of the answer.; Check the decisive unknown — Investigate information that could change the choice.; Answer with boundaries — Attach evidence, limits, and the next review condition..
